metadata.title: Antoine Ghigny · Digital Creation
metadata.description: Bespoke website and landing page design for freelancers and SMEs. Based in Nivelles, Belgium.

hero.description: I design bespoke websites for freelancers and SMEs. Fast, search-optimised and built to inspire trust. Your future clients find you and reach out.

professionalism.label: First Impression
professionalism.title: A site that makes visitors want to <highlight>contact</highlight> you from the very first visit.

trust.label: Credibility
trust.title: Visitors judge your professionalism in 3 seconds. Show an image that matches your real <highlight>expertise</highlight>.

performance.label: Visibility
performance.title: A fast, well-built site ranks higher on Google and AI engines. Your clients <highlight>find</highlight> you before your competitors.

design.label: Your Identity
design.title: A unique design that <highlight>sets you apart</highlight> and reflects exactly who you are.

client.description: Nobody knows your business better than you. You know what your clients are looking for and what convinces them.

my.description: I turn all of that into a site that works for you: visible on Google, clear for your visitors and designed to make them take the next step.

contact.title: Let's talk about your project.
contact.description: Tell me about your project in a few words. I'll get back to you quickly to see how I can help.

privacy.label: Security
privacy.title: Privacy & Cookies
privacy.content: We respect your privacy. For more details, see our dedicated privacy policy.

accessibility.label: Inclusion
accessibility.title: Digital Accessibility
accessibility.content: In accordance with the European Accessibility Act of 2025-2026, we are committed to making this site accessible to everyone. If you encounter any difficulty, please contact us.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.label: Personal Data
privacy.intro: Protecting your personal data is an absolute priority. We process your information in accordance with the GDPR in force in Belgium.

controller.label: Responsibility
controller.title: Data Controller
controller.content: Antoine Ghigny is the sole controller for the processing of your data collected on this site.

data.label: Collection
data.title: Collected Data
data.content: This website does not have a contact form and does not actively collect any personal data. When you contact us via WhatsApp or Email, we only process the information you choose to provide to respond to your inquiry.

rights.label: Your Rights
rights.title: Access & Rectification
rights.content: You have the right to access, rectify, and erase your data. Contact us for any request at antoine@ghigny.be.

cookies.label: Cookies
cookies.title: Cookie Management
cookies.content: We use essential technical cookies. No advertising cookies are placed without your explicit consent.
